houses.name: Rhino General's Watch
houses.line: Hold the center, secure the middle crossing, and await orders.

houses.name: Kite River General
houses.line: We shall hold the middle ford and wait for enemy movements.

houses.name: Orchid's Steady Hand
houses.line: Hold the banks, watch the paths. Patience is our shield.

houses.name: Tiger General's Watch
houses.line: We secure the west ford, seek a pact, and strike where needed.
